name: github.list_commits
description: list commits on a repository branch, filterable by date range, author or path

parameters.title: ListCommitsRequest

sha.title: Sha
sha.description: SHA hash or branch name to start listing commits from. If not provided, the GitHub API uses the repository's default branch (usually `main` or `master`). Please provide a value of type string.
sha.human_parameter_description: The branch name or a specific commit SHA to list commits from. Leave this blank to use the repository's default branch.

page.title: Page
page.description: Page number of the results to fetch when using pagination. Please provide a value of type integer.
page.human_parameter_description: Which page of results to view when there are many commits. Start with 1 for the first page.

path.title: Path
path.description: Only commits modifying this specific file path will be returned. Please provide a value of type string.
path.human_parameter_description: Limit results to commits that changed a particular file or folder path. Helpful when tracking changes to a specific file.

repo.title: Repo
repo.description: The name of the repository without the `.git` extension (repository name only, not the full 'owner/repo' path). Must contain only alphanumeric characters, hyphens (-), underscores (_), and periods (.). Wildcards like '*' are not supported. Please provide a value of type string. This parameter is required.
repo.human_parameter_description: The repository you want to view commits for, without the .git extension (just the repo name, not 'owner/repo'). It's the project name, like 'Spoon-Knife'.

owner.title: Owner
owner.description: The account owner of the repository (username or organization name only, not the full 'owner/repo' path). Must contain only alphanumeric characters and hyphens, cannot start/end with a hyphen, max 39 characters. Wildcards are not supported. Please provide a value of type string. This parameter is required.
owner.human_parameter_description: The username or organization that owns the repository (just the owner name, not 'owner/repo'). For example, 'octocat' or your org's name.

since.title: Since
since.description: Only commits created on or after this timestamp will be returned. This is a timestamp in ISO 8601 format: `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ`. Please provide a value of type string.
since.human_parameter_description: Only include commits on or after this date and time (ISO 8601). Use this to narrow results to a time window.

until.title: Until
until.description: Only commits created before this timestamp will be returned. This is a timestamp in ISO 8601 format: `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ`. Please provide a value of type string.
until.human_parameter_description: Only include commits before this date and time (ISO 8601). Use with Start date to define a date range.

author.title: Author
author.description: Filter commits by the commit author's GitHub login or email address. Please provide a value of type string.
author.human_parameter_description: Only show commits authored by this user or email address. Enter a GitHub username or an email.

per_page.title: Per Page
per_page.description: Number of results to return per page (max 100). Please provide a value of type integer.
per_page.human_parameter_description: How many commits to return per page. Increase this to see more results at once, up to 100.

committer.title: Committer
committer.description: Filter commits by the commit committer's GitHub login or email address. The committer is the user who applied the patch and may differ from the original author. Please provide a value of type string.
committer.human_parameter_description: Only show commits committed by this user or email (the person who applied the change). This can be different from the original author.

parameters.description: Request schema for `ListCommits`. Note: Commits are always returned in reverse chronological order (newest first). Sorting options are not available - do not use 'sort' parameter.

name: github.list_organization_repositories
description: Retrieves a list of repositories for a specified GitHub organization, allowing filtering by type and sorting.

parameters.title: ListOrganizationRepositoriesRequest

org.title: Org
org.description: Name of the GitHub organization (not case-sensitive). Please provide a value of type string. This parameter is required.
org.human_parameter_description: The GitHub organization whose repositories you want to see. Use the organization’s handle (what appears in the URL), like 'github' or 'microsoft'.

page.title: Page
page.description: Page number for pagination (starts from 1). Please provide a value of type integer.
page.human_parameter_description: Which page of results you want to view. Start with 1, then go to 2, 3, etc. to see more.

sort.title: Sort
sort.description: Property to sort repositories by: `created`, `updated`, `pushed`, or `full_name`. Please provide a value of type string.
sort.human_parameter_description: How you want the list ordered, such as by when repos were created, last updated, last pushed, or by name. Pick what makes it easiest to browse.

type.title: Type
type.description: Specifies the type of repositories to return: `all`, `public`, `private` (requires permissions), `forks`, `sources` (not forks), or `member` (repositories with explicit user access). Please provide a value of type string.
type.human_parameter_description: Choose which kinds of repositories to include, like all, public, private, forks, sources, or ones you’re a member of. This helps narrow the list to what you care about.

per_page.title: Per Page
per_page.description: Number of results per page (maximum 100). Please provide a value of type integer.
per_page.human_parameter_description: How many repositories to show on each page of results. Increase to see more at once (up to 100).

direction.title: DirectionEnm
direction.description: Sort order: `asc` (ascending) or `desc` (descending). Defaults to `asc` if `sort` is `full_name`, else `desc`. Please provide a value of type string.
direction.human_parameter_description: Whether the list should go from low to high (ascending) or high to low (descending). Choose the direction that fits how you want to scan results.

parameters.description: Request to list repositories for a specified GitHub organization.

name: github.list_organizations_for_the_authenticated_user
description: Lists organizations the authenticated GitHub user is a member of, returning details for each organization.

parameters.title: ListOrganizationsForTheAuthenticatedUserRequest

page.title: Page
page.description: The page number of the results to retrieve, used for pagination. Default is 1. Please provide a value of type integer.
page.human_parameter_description: Which page of results you want to view. Start at 1, then go to 2, 3, and so on to see later pages.

per_page.title: Per Page
per_page.description: The number of organization results to return per page. Default is 30, maximum is 100. Please provide a value of type integer.
per_page.human_parameter_description: How many organization results to show on each page. Increase this to see more results at once (up to 100).

parameters.description: Defines the parameters for paginating the list of organizations for the authenticated user.

name: github.list_repositories_for_the_authenticated_user
description: Lists repositories for the authenticated user; using 'type' with 'visibility' or 'affiliation' API parameters (not in this model) can cause a 422 error.

page.title: Page
page.description: Page number of results to fetch. Please provide a value of type integer.
page.human_parameter_description: Which page of results you want to view. Use this to move through the list when there are many repositories.

sort.title: Sort
sort.description: The repository property by which to sort the results. Please provide a value of type string.
sort.human_parameter_description: Select the property to order the results by, like creation date, last update, or full name. Pick what makes browsing easiest for you.

type.title: Type
type.description: Filters the results to repositories of the specified type. Please provide a value of type string.
type.human_parameter_description: Choose which repositories to include, such as all, only ones you own, or those you’re a member of. This helps narrow the list to what matters to you.

since.title: Since
since.description: Filters for repositories updated at or after this specified time. Provide as an ISO 8601 formatted timestamp. Please provide a value of type string.
since.human_parameter_description: Only show repositories updated at or after this date and time. Helpful for focusing on recent activity from a specific point.

before.title: Before
before.description: Filters for repositories updated before this specified time. Provide as an ISO 8601 formatted timestamp. Please provide a value of type string.
before.human_parameter_description: Only show repositories updated before this date and time. Helpful for reviewing activity that happened earlier.

per_page.title: Per Page
per_page.description: The number of results to return per page (maximum 100). Please provide a value of type integer.
per_page.human_parameter_description: How many repositories to show per page. Set a higher number to see more at once (up to 100).

direction.title: DirectionEnm
direction.description: The direction of the sort. Defaults to `asc` when `sort` is 'full_name', and `desc` otherwise. Please provide a value of type string.
direction.human_parameter_description: Choose whether the list is sorted ascending or descending. For example, A–Z vs Z–A, or oldest first vs newest first.

name: github.list_branches
description: List branches in a GitHub repository. Returns branch names, commit information, and protection status. Use this action when you need to retrieve all branches in a repository, optionally filtered by protection status. This is useful for identifying available branches, checking which branches are protected, or preparing to create pull requests.

page.title: Page
page.description: The page number of the results to fetch. For more information, see 'Using pagination in the REST API'. Please provide a value of type integer.

repo.title: Repo
repo.description: The name of the repository without the `.git` extension. The name is not case sensitive. Please provide a value of type string. This parameter is required.

owner.title: Owner
owner.description: The account owner of the repository. The name is not case sensitive. Please provide a value of type string. This parameter is required.

per_page.title: Per Page
per_page.description: The number of results per page (max 100). For more information, see 'Using pagination in the REST API'. Please provide a value of type integer.

protected.title: Protected
protected.description: Setting to `true` returns only branches protected by branch protections or rulesets. When set to `false`, only unprotected branches are returned. Omitting this parameter returns all branches. Please provide a value of type boolean.
